summary: yum_repository options: attributes, bandwidth, baseurl (one of baseurl/metalink/mirrorlist required), cost, countme, deltarpm_percentage, and description (required for present).
questions: What's required to add a yum repository?
How do I give a yum repo multiple base URLs?
How do I set repo priority by cost?
How do I disable delta RPMs?

answer_card.title: yum_repository parameters (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `baseurl`: URL or list; one of `baseurl`/`metalink`/`mirrorlist` required for `present`
- `description`: repo `name` field; required for `present`
- `cost`, `bandwidth`, `countme`
- `deltarpm_percentage`: `0` disables
